summary.text: The Blackblade is a mystical soul-drinking sword forged by Dakkon, later wielded by Gideon Jura against Belzenlok, Rhonas and Nicol Bolas before it shattered.

bio.text: Dakkon forged it for Geyadrone Dihada at her urging, sacrificing his own blood, then his son, then countless slaves, and Dihada then stabbed it into his shadow to bind his soul into the blade.
Dakkon used it to kill Piru, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
Around 4560 AR it came into the hands of the Cabal minion Needle, and the Cabal rewrote its origins.
Gideon stole it from the Cabal vaults and lodged it in Belzenlok's leg, and Liliana then used it to drain Belzenlok's life and kill him.
In the War of the Spark Gideon stabbed the God-Eternal Rhonas with it, draining him to dust.
Gideon struck Bolas's head with it, but it broke because Bolas had enchanted it to never hurt another elder dragon.

status.text: The Blackblade shattered against Bolas during the War of the Spark, and no later story shows it restored.
